tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[ODE decay estimate] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0031 1. ch10:10.5\group Scalar maximum principles

If $x\ge 0$ and $x'\le -C_1x^{1+\alpha }$ whenever $x\ge C_2$, then \[ x(t)\le \max \{ (C_1\alpha t)^{-1/\alpha },C_2\} . \] \end{example}
Proof

\sketch On every interval where $x\ge C_2$, differentiation gives $(x^{-\alpha })'=-\alpha x^{-1-\alpha }x'\ge C_1\alpha $. Integrating until the first time $x=C_2$ yields the displayed estimate; after that time the definition of the first hitting time gives $x\le C_2$.

□
